import this.import // Single spacing after imports

public class className {
    public int publicField; // Fields at top of class

    public className(int field) {
        publicField = field; // Different names, so we can avoid using "this.publicField" for consistency
    }

    public int getPublicField() { // Accessors and then mutators at the top, beneath the constructor
        return publicField;
    }

    public void setPublicField(int fieldValue) { // "get" or "set" before the name of the value being accessed or mutated
        publicField = fieldValue;
    }

    static {
        // Static block space if needed
    }

    public returnType publicMethod() {
        int integerValue = 1; // Most primiative data type at the top
        int secondInt;
        float floatingPoint = 0.1F;
        double floatDouble = 0.2;
    }

    private returnType privateMethod() {
        int number = 0;

        if (number > 1) { // Single spacing separating variables from method calls, if statement blocks, etc.
            int secondNumber = 1;

            setpublicField(secondNumber);
        }
    }

    private class innerClass { // Single spacing for pretty much everything
        public final float VALUE_OF_PI = 3.14; // Final numerical variables can have uppercase camel-case names
    }
}
